Name: Navy SkillsBooks
Author: Ppku123
Description:
Navy Skills Books
[b]14 Power Books. Permanent Abilities. New Ways to Progress.[/b]
Navy Skills Books adds 14 unique Power Books to Stardew Valley. Each book grants a permanent ability, offering new ways to improve farming, fishing, mining, combat, and other aspects of gameplay.
Books can be obtained through their designated shops, progression requirements, or special in-game sources.
This release introduces [b]partial multiplayer support[/b] while preserving all 14 abilities in single-player.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]14 unique Power Books with permanent abilities.[/*]
[*]Progression-based acquisition through skills and, where applicable, Mastery.[/*]
[*]Integration with Stardew Valley's book-reading system.[/*]
[*]Power entries in Special Items & Powers.[/*]
[*]Persistent unlocks across save sessions.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer shared-power synchronization.[/*]
[*]Individual skill and Mastery requirements for book purchases.[/*]
[/list][heading]Single-player[/heading]
All 14 Power Books retain their gameplay effects in single-player.
[heading]Multiplayer — Public Beta[/heading]
Five Power Books currently provide gameplay bonuses in multiplayer:
[b]Supported Powers[/b]
[list]
[*]Legendary Angler's Legacy[/*]
[*]Treasure Hunter's Journal[/*]
[*]Traveler's Endurance[/*]
[*]Artisan's Handbook[/*]
[*]Warrior's Instinct[/*]
[/list]The following nine books are readable but their gameplay effects are disabled in multiplayer:
[b]Readable Only[/b]
[list]
[*]Harvesting Secrets[/*]
[*]Efficient Mining[/*]
[*]Explorer's Wisdom[/*]
[*]Secrets of Growth[/*]
[*]Animal Care Handbook[/*]
[*]Harvest Sovereignty[/*]
[*]Heart of the Earth[/*]
[*]Forest's Abundance[/*]
[*]Sovereign of Battle[/*]
[/list]Important Multiplayer Limitations
[list]
[*]Power unlocks are shared across the farm.[/*]
[*]Only the Host can perform the first unlock of a book's power.[/*]
[*]Farmhands can use supported powers already unlocked by the Host.[/*]
[*]Farmhands can reread books after the farm has unlocked them.[/*]
[*]Readable-Only books do not provide gameplay bonuses in multiplayer.[/*]
[*]Book purchasing requirements are checked individually for each player.[/*]
[*]All multiplayer participants must install compatible versions of both mod components.[/*]
[*]Explorer's Wisdom retains its single-player-only mine-chest acquisition behavior.[/*]
[/list][b]Multiplayer functionality has undergone automated and simulated synchronization testing, but has not yet been validated through live online multiplayer sessions.[/b]
Please back up your save files before installing this Public Beta.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]Developed and tested with Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.5.2, and Content Patcher 2.9.1.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download Navy Skills Books.[/*]
[*]Extract the archive into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Make sure both
[code]Navy Skills Books[/code]and
[code][CP] Navy Skills Books[/code]are installed.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]For multiplayer, every participant should install the same mod version and Content Patcher pack version.
[heading]Updating[/heading]
Close the game before updating.
Back up your saves and replace both mod components with the matching new versions. Do not mix files from different releases.
[heading]Known Limitations[/heading]
[list]
[*]Farmhands cannot perform the first farm-wide Power Book unlock.[/*]
[*]Nine books provide no gameplay effects in multiplayer.[/*]
[*]Explorer's Wisdom's original mine-chest acquisition is restricted to single-player.[/*]
[*]Live online multiplayer and split-screen sessions have not yet been fully verified.[/*]
[/list][heading]Bug Reports and Feedback[/heading]
Feedback is welcome during this Public Beta.
When reporting an issue, please include:
[list]
[*]Mod version[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley version[/*]
[*]SMAPI and Content Patcher versions[/*]
[*]Single-player or multiplayer[/*]
[*]Host or Farmhand[/*]
[*]The book involved[/*]
[*]Steps to reproduce the problem[/*]
[*]Expected and actual results[/*]
[*]SMAPI log, if available[/*]
[/list]Please remove any personal or sensitive information before sharing logs.
Thank you for trying Navy Skills Books!
